visual_environment.illumination: Clear high-noon or glass-bright light with minimal shadow and no hidden source.
visual_environment.palette: Cool transparent air, pale stone, clear blue, honest parchment, and restrained bright accents.
visual_environment.atmosphere: Exposed, legible, unoccluded, and answerable to scrutiny.
visual_environment.density: Low-to-moderate; clutter recedes so evidence can be seen.
visual_environment.material_effects: Ink lines clarify, glaze thins, gold/reflection sharpens; nothing should be concealed by atmospheric flourish.

visual_environment.illumination: Warm low golden light that wraps rather than isolates.
visual_environment.palette: Honey gold, soft red-brown, warm cream, muted rose, and hearth amber.
visual_environment.atmosphere: Close, humid, tender, sheltering, and responsive to suffering.
visual_environment.motion: Enfolding, bending toward, gathering, or sharing.
visual_environment.material_effects: Edges soften, parchment warms, and glazes blend gently without erasing family structure.

visual_environment.illumination: Bright hard frontal or storm-charged light at the instant one steps forward.
visual_environment.palette: Hot white, clarion gold, saturated red, steel blue, and storm-dark contrast.
visual_environment.motion: Forward thrust, rise, or deliberate advance.
visual_environment.density: Sparse around a decisive focal action.
visual_environment.material_effects: Ink cuts sharpen, highlights flare, and directional marks align with forward movement.

visual_environment.illumination: Even balanced light from two sides with neither source dominating.
visual_environment.palette: Measured gray, muted blue, parchment, and balanced gold.
visual_environment.atmosphere: Poised, weighed, formal, and held just before verdict.
visual_environment.motion: Counterbalance, reciprocal adjustment, or suspended equilibrium.
visual_environment.material_effects: Contrasts equalize, margins/symmetries become legible, and decorative weight is kept proportionate.

visual_environment.illumination: Reddened ember light visibly depleting as it gives warmth elsewhere.
visual_environment.palette: Ember red, dark umber, spent gold, smoke gray, and fading orange.
visual_environment.atmosphere: Costly, beautiful, diminishing, and freely offered rather than merely destroyed.
visual_environment.motion: Outflow, emptying, burning down, or transfer away from the source.
visual_environment.density: High at the spent source, dispersing outward.
visual_environment.material_effects: Gold dulls, pigment thins, smoke rises, and luminous material visibly leaves one form to sustain another.

visual_environment.illumination: Formal vertical light with columnar emphasis and disciplined highlights.
visual_environment.palette: Burnished steel, restrained gold, deep blue, and ceremonial parchment.
visual_environment.atmosphere: Upright, dignified, public, a little cold, and bound by the kept word.
visual_environment.motion: Rise, stand, present, or hold position.
visual_environment.material_effects: Verticals straighten, metallic/gold accents burnish, and edges gain formal clarity without becoming glossy.

visual_environment.illumination: Diffuse radiant light from everywhere and nowhere, without a single cast-shadow source.
visual_environment.palette: Pale gold, moon-silver, soft spectral color, luminous parchment, and airy blue-white.
visual_environment.atmosphere: Rarefied, expansive, weightless, communal, and near-numinous.
visual_environment.motion: Opening, rising, circulating, or dissolving boundaries into relation.
visual_environment.density: Low and breathable around a shared luminous field.
visual_environment.material_effects: Glazes become translucent, borders soften, and highlights connect separate forms without erasing their identities.

visual_environment.illumination: Low level dusk or earthbound light close to the ground.
visual_environment.palette: Humble brown, slate, muted green, worn parchment, and low warm gray.
visual_environment.atmosphere: Quiet, grounded, right-sized, teachable, and small under a wide world.
visual_environment.motion: Settling, kneeling, lowering, returning, or yielding space.
visual_environment.density: Weight gathers low; upper space stays open.
visual_environment.material_effects: Gold recedes, pigments earth down, surfaces scuff/wear, and the page's own material becomes newly visible.
